Here is a quick overview of how our returns and refunds work.
Standard returns window
Return items from orders placed directly with us within 30 days of receipt, in their original condition, for a refund of the amount you paid.
UK returns are free.
Sale items
You have 14 days from receipt to register your return with our online returns partner, then a further 14 days to send the item back, in original condition.
How to start a return
Register your return and create your label via our online returns partner (opens in a new tab).
Non‑refundable items
Swimwear if the hygiene strip has been removed.
Earrings if the internal packaging seal has been broken.
Discounts and offers
Offers are applied per item. Any items you keep keep their discount. Returned items are refunded at the price you paid after the discount.
Exchanges
We do not offer exchanges. Please return for a refund and place a new order online for the item you would like instead.
Quality guarantee
After the standard return period (or 14 days for sale items), you can return anything that does not meet our quality standards for up to one year after your order arrived.
Within 6 months: we will refund your item.
Between 6 and 12 months: we will credit your account for the amount paid. Account credit has no expiry date and can be used on any future order, including sale items.
If a discount or offer was used, we adjust the amount accordingly.
Pre‑orders
If you return an item from an order that still has an outstanding pre‑order, the cost of that outstanding item may be deducted from your refund. Any remaining balance is refunded to your original payment method.
Delivery fees
Express delivery fees cannot be refunded if a parcel arrives late.
